Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great context on your latency goals and the regulatory constraints for your EU/US pipelines. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive (private/VPC/on‑prem architecture review):

Summary from discovery:
- Primary workload: document processing + embeddings for logistics routing; spikes around end‑of‑month batch jobs
- Data residency: US primary, EU for EU customers (possible multi‑region)
- Compliance: SOC 2 in scope; need audit log retention and KMS integration
- Desired outcome for next call: architecture diagram walkthrough, network connectivity options (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink), KMS/HSM approach, and ops runbook for failover

Proposed ask: can we schedule a 60‑minute architecture review next week? Two proposed 60‑minute windows (PT):
- Wed Jul 15, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Jul 16, 09:00–10:00 PT

Suggested attendees from our side: me (Account), Connor Obrien (Solutions Engineer), Ben Carter (Infra SME) — we’ll bring a prepopulated checklist and a draft SOW to discuss high‑level options. Please include your network/security folks if possible (we typically find a network engineer + security/compliance owner helpful).

Prep attachments: I’m attaching a short Redwood priv‑deploy checklist and a blank SOW draft so you can see what we’d discuss. If you have a current topology (CIDR ranges, VPN/jumpbox notes), please attach that to your reply — it helps speed the review.

If neither slot works, send two alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the recap and checklist. Both slots look reasonable; our team prefers to target Wed Jul 15, 10:00–11:00 PT but I want to confirm with Security. If that works for you, tentative yes.

A few items from our side we’d like on the agenda:
- SOC 2 artifact expectations and timeline (we can share our current report)
- Data ingress/egress patterns (we do nightly ingestion + streaming spikes)
- Minimum bandwidth and expected egress limits (cost sensitivity)

1) 5m — Introductions + objectives
2) 15m — Current topology walkthrough (you) + pain points
3) 20m — Redwood private/VPC options: peering vs PrivateLink vs VPN, CIDR considerations, and KMS/HSM integration patterns
4) 10m — Ops: KV cache strategies, backup/retention, audit log export options, and runbook overview
5) 10m — Q&A + next steps (POC criteria & SOW milestones)

Prep requests: can you share (before the call) the tentative CIDR ranges you plan to use for private endpoints, and whether you prefer a carrier VPN or a site‑to‑site appliance? Also confirm which of your security/compliance folks will attend so we can allocate time for SOC 2 artifact discussion.
